title: Oakmobile
body:
"BLUE SHELL NOT INCLUDED. 100 TOP SPEED. MUCH FAST. MUCH WOW."

The Oakmobile is a vehicle that can be purchased from the Lighthouse for $6,500. It is a small runabout.

Details

Unlike other vehicles in the game, the Oakmobile has no cargo space to store wood. Instead, the Oakmobile has a bench seat that can seat four players (including driver). Additionally, the Oakmobile has its hitch on the front rather in the back. The Oakmobile used to have fastest top speed of any vehicle in the game at 101 studs/s, with no slowdown for going offroad. However, due to the vehicle's incredibly short wheelbase, the Oakmobile is incredibly unstable and will flip over with ease. It also has limited steering angle to prevent it from simply flipping over while turning under acceleration.

Unusually, the player can grab the headrest of the Oakmobile, allowing the user to lift it and move it. This allows the user to unflip the Oakmobile at any time. It cannot be moved by a grabber, however.

Trivia

  • The Oakmobile used to be 125 stud/s originally, but the speed was lowered due to it mostly spinning out of control.
    • The Oakmobile received a further patch to improve its stability by reducing its maximum steering angle and acceleration.
  • The Oakmobile is the only vehicle to have no cargo space, more than two seats, and a hitch on the front.
  • The Oakmobile's description contains a few references:
    • "BLUE SHELL NOT INCLUDED" references the Blue Shell powerup from Mario Kart.
    • "MUCH FAST, MUCH WOW" references the Doge meme, in which a picture of a Shiba Inu dog is edited with grammatically incorrect phrases and sentences.
  • The hitch can be used on trailers and you can move by reversing, however its better to use the Sellner Explorer or the Joop grand Barrow for trailers
  • Using the gravity coil while on the Oakmobile makes a large diffrence in how it drives.. The car becomes bouncy and is hard to actually even drive.
    • The car will bounce around, does a wheelie when you accelerate fowards, gets a bit more air time, and is just silly to use.
    • If you run into a wall, it will flip on its side, possibly do a backflip, and then go on its side if you move.
    • Holding W will make it spin out eventually. It will not go straight, no matter what you do.
  • You can use the Oakmobile to find meteor crash sites, then hit each tree with your axe to claim ownership of all the trees that spawn in it.
